stem: Linear function t has an x-intercept of -1 and a y-intercept of 5. Which graph best represents t?
visual_elements: Graph A: line crossing x-axis near -1 and y-axis near 0, slight positive slope
Graph B: line crossing x-axis near 6 and y-axis near 6, steep negative slope
Graph C: line crossing x-axis near -1 and y-axis near 6, steep negative slope
Graph D: line crossing x-axis near 0 and y-axis near 6, steep positive slope
